$comment: FIT-04 export-contract registry. Every exception must name the export, the exact rule(s) it covers (auth / error_code / sensitive_read_audit), a reason, an owner and an expiry date. tests/architecture/test_export_contracts.py fails on an expired entry, an unknown export, a duplicate entry, and an entry whose listed exceptions no longer match the code (fixed gaps must delete their entry). Do not add an entry to hide a new unguarded export; add the gate/error code/audit instead.
